use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE

use Grid = List[List[bool]]

let columns = 80
let rows = 60
let cell = 4
let generations = 160

let gun = [
    "........................#...........",
    "......................#.#...........",
    "............##......##............##",
    "...........#...#....##............##",
    "##........#.....#...##..............",
    "##........#...#.##....#.#...........",
    "..........#.....#.......#...........",
    "...........#...#....................",
    "............##......................"
]

in_gun(row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    row >= 0 /\ row < gun.count /\
    column >= 0 /\ column < gun[row].length /\
    gun[row][column] == '#'

start() -> Grid =>
    (0..rows)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..columns)
                |> map(column => in_gun(row - 4, column - 4))
                |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

live_neighbours(grid: Grid, row: int, column: int) -> int is
    let count mut = 0

    for dr in -1::1 do
        for dc in -1::1 do
            let r = (row + dr + rows) % rows
            let c = (column + dc + columns) % columns

            if !(dr == 0 /\ dc == 0) /\ grid[r][c] then
                count = count + 1
            fi
        od
    od

    count
si

survives(grid: Grid, row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    let neighbours = live_neighbours(grid, row, column) in
    if grid[row][column] then
        neighbours == 2 \/ neighbours == 3
    else
        neighbours == 3
    fi

step(grid: Grid) -> Grid =>
    (0..rows)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..columns)
                |> map(column => survives(grid, row, column))
                |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

draw(image: IMAGE, grid: Grid) is
    image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 247ub)
    image.colour(35ub, 70ub, 130ub)

    for row in 0..rows do
        for column in 0..columns do
            if grid[row][column] then
                image.fill_rectangle(
                    cast double(column * cell),
                    cast double(row * cell),
                    cast double(column * cell + cell),
                    cast double(row * cell + cell))
            fi
        od
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(columns * cell, rows * cell)
let animation = ANIMATION(columns * cell, rows * cell)

let grid mut = start()

for _ in 0..generations do
    draw(image, grid)

    animation.add(image, 50)

    grid = step(grid)
od

animation.write("gun.png")

animation.show("gun.png")
